name: Articuno
description: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed stats of the user and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.description: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Mind Reader
moves.description: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.description: The target faints instantly. It’s less likely to hit the target if it’s used by Pokémon other than Ice types.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target two to five times in a row.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.
